text:
Alex (AE): quick question — ACME Labs wants a 60-day on-prem POC (air-gapped option). They're pushing to remove the platform fee for the eval. Can we do a waiver?
Marta (Sales Lead): what's the ask exactly? waive platform fee entirely or discount + commit?
Alex (AE): they'd like the platform fee removed for the POC period. Will consider a 12mo reserved commit if POC goes well. No firm commit yet, just a conversation.
Devin (Deal Desk): need justification + expected ARR conversion rate. waivers without a path to commit are rare. Can you share expected endpoint size / team using it?
Ira (SE): for on-prem we usually factor in installation, KMS integration, and an on-site support window. sizing: 2x A100 equiv for the POC (burst), ~8 concurrent users, seq len 2-4k typical.
Tasha (CS): also need to know whether SSO/KMS+audit logs are required during POC. If yes, we include a POC runbook and 4 hours onboarding support.
Alex (AE): ACME asked for SSO and KMS in-scope for POC (SSO via SAML, KMS for key wrapping). They're sensitive about data residency.
PricingBot: automated note — standard on-prem platform fee = one-time platform onboarding fee ($25k) + monthly platform license ($3k/mo). Support Bronze = $2k/mo, Silver = $7k/mo.
Marta (Sales Lead): Devin — can we offer a conditional waiver: waive the one-time onboarding fee for a 3mo trial, or defer it until conversion (paid if they commit to 12mo within 90 days)?
Devin (Deal Desk): that's reasonable. Propose: defer onboarding fee, apply a 50% discount to first 3 months of platform license, and include Bronze support for the POC at no charge. Require an MOU committing to evaluate and a named POC owner.
Sanjay (Finance): deferral OK but need revenue recognition path. If deferred and not converted, the fee becomes invoiced and recognized as catch-up. Approve deferral for up to 90 days.
LegalBot: flag — air-gapped deployments require the on-prem addendum + updated indemnity clauses. I'll surface the template; expect 7-10 business days for sig.
Ira (SE): technical note — if we defer onboarding, SE time still needs coverage. We'll allocate 8 hours of onboarding SE as part of the POC. Additional hours billed at standard rate.
Alex (AE): to be clear: proposal to customer = onboarding fee deferred until conversion; 50% off platform license for first 3 months; Bronze support included for 60-day POC; must sign MOU and complete security questionnaire.
Marta (Sales Lead): sounds good. Devin — please formalize in a short deal memo and route to approval. Include these conditions: MOU, named POC owner, SSO & KMS checklist complete, on-prem addendum signoff.
Devin (Deal Desk): will do. Draft memo ETA EOD. If Deal Desk signs off, approval path -> Marta -> Finance.
Sanjay (Finance): once memo in, I'll confirm deferred revenue entries and set billing trigger.
Tasha (CS): I'll prepare a POC runbook checklist (SSO, KMS, logs, rollback plan) and send to Alex for customer review.
Alex (AE): thanks all. One more ask — any quick quote lines I can drop in the customer email now?
Ira (SE): drop-in quote snippet:```
SKUs:
- ONPREM-ONBOARD (deferred) 1x — list $25,000 — deferred until conversion
- ONPREM-LICENSE-MO (discounted) 3x months — list $3,000/mo — applied 50% for initial 3 months
- SUPPORT-BRONZE (POC) 2 months — included
Notes: POC limited to 60 days; MOU and on-prem addendum required; additional SE hours billed separately.
```
Marta (Sales Lead): good. Add a sentence: "If customer converts to a 12-month reserved commitment within 90 days after POC, onboarding fee will be waived permanently and applied as credit toward first invoice."
Devin (Deal Desk): added to memo. I'll include conversion window and credit mechanics.
Alex (AE): I'll send MOU + security questionnaire to ACME and try to lock POC dates next week.
Tasha (CS): ping me if they want a dry-run. I'll schedule a 30-min prep call with SEs.
Marta (Sales Lead): thanks team — please react with :thumbsup: once memo posted.
Devin (Deal Desk): posting memo now -> link: https://redwood.company/dealdesk/memos/2076543210 (internal).
Sanjay (Finance): reviewed. :white_check_mark:
Ira (SE): ready on standby.
Alex (AE): closing loop — I'll update thread after customer reply.
